  path={"/zones/{zoneId}/aisles"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Adds an Aisle scoped to the given Zone. Its identity is the zone id plus the aisle code (e.g. `WH1-STOR-AMB-A07`), the first four segments of every LocationCode inside it. The SequenceHint is the aisle's walk-order position — lower comes earlier on the route — and is the concrete travel-distance input downstream WES planning consumes. An Aisle cannot be registered against an unknown or non-Active Zone. Publishes AisleRegistered.
